item.title: Kannawa Onsen Town — Guide
item.description: Kannawa is the most atmospheric of Beppu’s eight hot-spring areas and one of the most evocative onsen townscapes in Japan. Here the geothermal power is so intense that clouds of white steam constantly billow up from vents, drains and rooftops all over the hillside district, drifting between the old wooden inns, narrow lanes and shops and wrapping the whole town in a dreamlike, primeval haze. Strolling the steaming streets — a walk sometimes called the ‘yukemuri’ (steam) experience — is a magical, only-in-Beppu pleasure, especially atmospheric in the cool of morning or evening when the steam is thickest.
